content.short: Penn Blockchain educates and inspires students at UPenn to become blockchain leaders.
content.description: Penn Blockchain is a community-driven student organization at the University of Pennsylvania that brings together both graduate and undergraduate members to learn, explore, and apply blockchain technology. Through a program of events, hands-on workshops, hackathons, and collaborative projects, the group fosters a welcoming community of blockchain enthusiasts and enables students to craft innovative solutions. Members gain foundational blockchain knowledge, connect with industry professionals through networking and mentorship, and participate in projects that apply distributed ledger technology to real-world problems.
content.meta: Penn Blockchain is a student-led community at UPenn for learning blockchain. Discover Penn Blockchain and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
